The shared Windows/Android media modules use a minimal build of FFmpeg 9.0.2.
FFmpeg is a general media decoder, not a game engine or game-port project.
The user authorized this decoder dependency on 2026-10-17.

Official source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-9.0.2.tar.xz
Archive SHA256: 8c3850283eb25fa026482078a04051e0be17347b09ef81a0849bec15a96e002e
Official signing-key fingerprint: FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8
The detached signature was checked before extraction.

License: GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 or later.
This build does not enable GPL, nonfree, or version-3-only components.
See COPYING.LGPLv2.1 alongside this notice and the copyright notices in
the unmodified source files under tools/ffmpeg-9.0.2.

Only the ASF demuxer, WMV3/WMA2, MS ADPCM, IMA WAV ADPCM, A-law and
mu-law decoders are requested. Programs,
network access, encoders, filters, devices, swscale and swresample are
disabled. The Android build retains ARM64/NEON optimizations. Decoder
instances use one thread, and library initialization uses platform locks.

Preparation: scripts/prepare_media_sources.py
Build: scripts/build_media_codec.py --target arm64
Exact configuration and library hashes: logs/media-codec-arm64-build.json
Windows build: scripts/build_media_codec.py --target windows

Before distributing a statically linked APK, its distribution must also
provide this license, the corresponding FFmpeg source and configuration,
and the application objects/link materials required for relinking with
a modified LGPL library. These materials must match the distributed APK.
The SDK packaging workflow supplies the matching source/configuration and
application link materials in WA2-shared-relink.zip beside the delivered hosts. Those
materials are kept outside the APK and contain no original game resources.
